findings.title: Requester lacks permission for destructive project action
findings.action: Require an owner/admin role and a fresh authorization event before deletion or archive.

findings.title: Deletion escrow window is too short
findings.action: Extend the scheduled deletion time or route to manual institutional review.

findings.title: No rollback checkpoint is attached
findings.evidence: project-quantum-cell-archive has no rollback checkpoint for delete.
findings.action: Create a recovery snapshot before irreversible archive/delete execution.

findings.title: No pre-delete export bundle is attached
findings.evidence: project-quantum-cell-archive has no export bundle for delete.
findings.action: Generate a manifest-backed export bundle before allowing destructive project changes.

findings.title: Published DOI project lacks a tombstone plan
findings.action: Prepare DOI tombstone and citation-preservation metadata before deletion.

findings.title: Indexed project lacks a redirect URL
findings.evidence: project-quantum-cell-archive is indexed with no redirectUrl.
findings.action: Add a persistent redirect for search engines, institutional repositories, and citations.

findings.title: Not all active collaborators were notified
findings.evidence: user-reviewer did not receive deletion notice.
findings.action: Notify all active collaborators and give them a chance to export, fork, or dispute the action.

findings.title: Collaborator notice window is shorter than policy
findings.action: Delay execution until the configured collaborator notice period has elapsed.

findings.title: Project is under legal or compliance hold
findings.action: Block deletion until legal/compliance owners release the hold.

findings.title: Project has active review dependencies
findings.evidence: project-quantum-cell-archive has active reviews: peer-review-17, grant-closeout-04.
findings.action: Pause deletion until open peer review, grant, or institutional review dependencies are resolved.

findings.title: Private fork attribution has not been migrated
findings.evidence: project-quantum-cell-archive has private forks without migrated attribution.
findings.action: Migrate attribution records so downstream forks keep provenance after deletion.

findings.title: Project has unsettled compute charges
findings.action: Settle or waive compute charges before project deletion.
